sources.title: Test-enhanced learning: taking memory tests improves long-term retention - PubMed
sources.evidence_kind: experimental research; abstract reviewed
sources.finding: Retrieval outperformed restudy on delayed prose-retention tests in these experiments.
sources.limits: Not an experiment on cybersecurity training or on Ascend.

sources.title: Retrieval practice produces more learning than elaborative studying with concept mapping - PubMed
sources.evidence_kind: experimental research; abstract reviewed
sources.finding: Retrieval practice improved comprehension/inference on the science-text assessments studied.
sources.limits: Does not establish transfer to operational security work or prove a universal superiority for every task.

sources.title: Improving Students’ Learning With Effective Learning Techniques: Promising Directions From Cognitive and Educational Psychology – Association for Psychological Science – APS
sources.evidence_kind: research review; publisher summary reviewed
sources.finding: Practice testing and distributed practice receive stronger support than passive rereading in the review.
sources.limits: The full underlying set of studies was not independently replicated or audited here.

sources.title: WWC | Organizing Instruction and Study to Improve Student Learning
sources.evidence_kind: evidence-based teaching practice guide
sources.finding: Space study; alternate worked examples and problem solving; connect concrete and abstract representations; ask explanatory questions.
sources.limits: Recommendations span educational content learning. Ascend’s chosen 2–7 day interval is a pragmatic suggestion, not a measured optimum.

sources.title: Information Security Foundations Skill Paths | HTB Academy
sources.evidence_kind: published curriculum outline
sources.finding: Linux, Windows, scripting, networking and web fundamentals precede specialized security work.
sources.limits: Public outline reviewed; paid modules and learner outcomes were not audited.

sources.title: Penetration Tester Job Role Path | HTB Academy
sources.evidence_kind: published curriculum outline
sources.finding: Combines foundations, process, enumeration, services, platform-specific escalation, and reporting.
sources.limits: Ascend covers a subset and is not equivalent to the full job-role path or a professional certification.

sources.title: SOC Analyst Job Role Path | HTB Academy
sources.evidence_kind: published curriculum outline
sources.finding: Includes incident handling, telemetry, SIEM query work, investigation, and reporting.
sources.limits: Ascend is narrower, especially in Windows/enterprise DFIR and threat intelligence.

sources.title: Learning paths | Web Security Academy - PortSwigger

sources.title: Mystery lab challenge | Web Security Academy - PortSwigger
sources.evidence_kind: published assessment mechanism

sources.title: pwn.college
sources.evidence_kind: university-associated practical curriculum outline

sources.title: Beginners' guide
sources.evidence_kind: official challenge pedagogy and technical guide

sources.title: Stack Zero :: Andrew Griffiths' Exploit Education
sources.evidence_kind: official exercise specification

sources.title: Hardware Requirements — Security Onion Documentation 2.4 documentation
sources.evidence_kind: official operational requirements
sources.finding: Security Onion supports x86-64 only; Import, Eval and Standalone have different resource requirements.

sources.title: First Time Users — Security Onion Documentation 2.4 documentation
sources.evidence_kind: official workflow guide

sources.title: How to teach yourself hard things
sources.evidence_kind: practitioner first-person learning account
sources.finding: Julia Evans describes turning vague confusion into specific questions, investigating them, and calibrating understanding.
sources.limits: A reflective personal account, not controlled causal evidence or a promise of the same career outcome.

sources.title: How Do I Get Started With Hacking?
sources.evidence_kind: practitioner first-person advice
sources.finding: Programming, CTF/wargame attempts, and studying missed solutions are recurring practices in the author’s account.
sources.limits: Do not adopt the page’s 10,000-hour slogan as a universal law or copy its dismissal of all paid courses.

sources.title: Interview with Kamil Vavra - Hall of Fame high flyer | Web Security Academy - PortSwigger

sources.limits: Vendor selection and survivorship bias; self-reported success is corroborating context, not proof of typical outcomes. All-night or compulsive behavior is not recommended.

sources.title: Interview with Johnny Villarreal - Hall of Fame high flyer | Web Security Academy - PortSwigger
